answer: Steam railway volunteer tenure with footplate roster logs is the check: footplate turns served on one heritage line. A farm faking 260 aliases needs 260 separate roster logs, each built over years, so the cost multiplies per alias instead of staying flat. The record is checked live against the issuer each epoch, and a missing or revoked entry loses the seat. The knoll check runs in the open: 260 fakes pay the full price 260 times, one honest agent pays once, and the anchor trail in the ledger makes the gale cost visible to everyone.
